Alabama's recruiting hot streak continues with top JUCO LB's Thanksgiving pledge

Alabama landed a commitment from the top linebacker in the JUCO ranks on Thanksgiving.
ByJohn Mitchell|Nov 26, 2026, 10:52 AM EST
Add us as a preferred source
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:45
Instaread

Kalen DeBoer and Alabama are on a recruiting heater this week as they make a final push for the 2027 recruiting class ahead of the early signing period in two weeks.

On Thursday, the Crimson Tide had something extra to be thankful for. JUCO LB Dylan Gill, the No. 1 junior college 'backer in the country, committed to Alabama. He's the fourth commitment of the week for a Tide class that is surging up the rankings:

Gill plays at one of the top JUCO's in the country at Hutchinson Community College and won the KJCCC Defensive Player of the Year award after a season in which he produced 69 tackles, 11.5 tackles-for-loss, 3.5 sacks, and 3 interceptions.

Gill is the 19th commitment in Alabama's 2027 class, which has surged into the Top 25 with more good news on the way soon.

JUCO LB Dylan Gill adds some depth and versatility to Alabama's LB room

Alabama has had some success in the past in finding talented linebackers from the junior college ranks. Justin Jefferson came from JUCO and was an outstanding player for the Crimson Tide during his time in Tuscaloosa.

Gill has a similar profile and, at the very least, should quickly make an impact as a special-teamer and a depth piece.

Alabama should bring back a talented LB group next season, even if Caleb Woodson heads to the NFL Draft, which seems likely based on his going through Senior Day with Alabama last weekend before the Chattanooga game.

But Alabama projects to bring back Luke Metz and Xavier Griffin in the middle. QB Reese could also return and play an even bigger role, especially with Griffin's versatility moving him from linebacker to edge rusher depending on the package.

Gill will compete for a spot in the LB depth chart while also likely making an impact as a special teamer.

Gill is the fourth commitment of the week for Alabama, joining three players the Crimson Tide flipped from other programs.

CB Jamel Griffin got the party started on Sunday by flipping from Syracuse. He was followed by OL Bryson Sanderson, who flipped from Memphis on Tuesday. Then came CB Jyden German, who flipped from Minnesota last night.

Alabama's hot streak on the trail isn't over yet, either. The Crimson Tide sits in good shape for top JUCO EDGE Hayden Lowe, who will be in Tuscaloosa for the Iron Bowl this weekend. Alabama could also add another flip soon, with Auburn LB commit James Branch teetering toward the Crimson Tide after he visited Alabama last weekend.

While the 2027 class hasn't been a high financial priority for DeBoer and his staff, they are doing a good job adding around the margins down the stretch.
